data.title: Gold and Bitcoin Are Starting to Rhyme? — But They Are Still Not the Same Hedge
data.description: The more important question is not whether Bitcoin is “digital gold.” It is whether the two assets are beginning to respond to the same macro forces.  For a long time, gold and Bitcoin belonged to very different parts of the market.
